description: This PHP source file defines a test double class 'FakeCalendarSyncJobFactory' for unit testing purposes. It replaces the real 'CalendarSyncJobFactory' to simulate job creation in-memory, avoiding database interactions. The class tracks created jobs, provides methods to retrieve and reset state, and allows injection of a fake scheduler.

classes.name: FakeCalendarSyncJobFactory
classes.description: A test double class for CalendarSyncJobFactory that in-memory tracks created calendar sync jobs for unit testing.

methods.name: getScheduler
methods.description: Returns the fake Scheduler object, if any has been set.

methods.name: setFakeScheduler
methods.description: Assigns a fake Scheduler object to this fake factory.

methods.name: createAccountJob
methods.description: Creates a fake account job, returning a unique fake job ID or null if input is invalid.

methods.name: createMeetingJob
methods.description: Creates a fake meeting job linked to an operation, returning a unique fake job ID or null if userId is missing.

methods.name: getCreatedAccountJobs
methods.description: Returns an array of all created account jobs with their details.

methods.name: getCreatedMeetingJobs
methods.description: Returns an array of all created meeting jobs with their details.

methods.name: wasAccountJobCreated
methods.description: Checks if any account jobs have been created.

methods.name: wasMeetingJobCreated
methods.description: Checks if any meeting jobs have been created.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state, clearing all tracked jobs and the fake scheduler.
